description: This pie chart illustrates the token routing distribution for a system labeled “FedHLM”. The chart contains three slices representing different routing destinations. A large, green slice is labeled “LOCAL” and comprises the vast majority of the chart’s area. A smaller, red slice is labeled “LLM” and accounts for approximately 3.9% of the chart. The remaining, blue slice is labeled “EDGE_P2P” and represents approximately 1.6% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed within the “LLM” and “EDGE_P2P” slices. A legend is present, though it only contains a gray square with no label. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slice, “LOCAL”, positioned at the bottom of the chart.
